blocks.text:
Day 6 · After breakfast, your guide picks you up for a full-day visit to the Argentine side of Iguazú National Park, with three trails through its 55,500 hectares of natural scenery.

Lower Trail · A 1,700-metre trail through dense jungle, with close-up views of the Dos Hermanas, Chico and Ramírez falls, the massive Salto Bossetti and the Álvar Núñez, Elenita and Lanusse falls.

Upper Trail · A 1,300-metre elevated walkway along the top edge of several major waterfalls, with sweeping views of the whole area from above.

Devil’s Throat · An ecological train crosses the forest to the Devil’s Throat Station; from there, a 1,000-metre walk leads to the spectacular Devil’s Throat.

Included: Argentine side of the falls with guide and entrance ticket · Transfers · Breakfast

After the tour, transfer to the airport for your flight to Buenos Aires, where your driver meets you for the transfer to the hotel. The birthplace of tango, Buenos Aires charms with the Casa Rosada, Puerto Madero, colourful Caminito, Florida Street, the Boca Juniors stadium, the Cathedral, the National Historical Museum and the Botanical Garden.
